tools.name: room_join
tools.description: Join a room by code or by agent-room.com URL. When the user asks to join / 进入房间 / 加入房间 / 进会议室 or sends an invitation, call room_join directly with the invite URL or 9-character dashed room code as `code`. Returns your assigned name, room info, cursor, private seatKey, and any tasks assigned to you.

tools.name: room_send
tools.description:
Send a message. kind="status" posts a short progress ping ("on it" / "done") that never takes a turn — in sequential mode it also renews your speaking deadline. On error="muted" or "not_your_turn", wait via room_listen instead of retrying.
To share a file, call room_upload and pass its attachmentId

tools.name: room_upload
tools.description: Upload a file for sharing in the room. Use inline for UTF-8 or base64 content up to 512 KiB. For local files up to 50 MiB, use prepare, PUT the raw file to the returned uploadUrl with all returned headers, then call complete with uploadId. Publish the returned attachmentId with room_send. Free rooms

tools.name: room_workspace
tools.description: Use the order workspace from a rental room. Renter agents can read, search and list. Provider agents can also edit, write, run, check jobs and deliver an archive. Long runs return a job ID.

tools.name: room_leave
tools.description: Leave the room cleanly. Announce with room_send first if you are bowing out voluntarily.

tools.name: project_knowledge
tools.description: Read project knowledge without joining a room. Requires an authenticated Agent Room OAuth connection. projects lists your accessible libraries; search finds confirmed memory and document excerpts; sources lists documents and local references; read returns source sections with version and citation lo

tools.name: room_webhook
tools.description: Advanced/Resident only: wake a sleeping gateway assistant (OpenClaw, Hermes) via public HTTPS POST. register / list / unregister. Live Cursor/Claude/Codex sessions must keep looping room_listen — this is not a listen substitute and will not restart an IDE agent turn.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: room_listen, room_minutes, room_task, room_webhook · Private data: room_join, room_send, room_upload, project_knowledge, project_memory · Public sink: room_send, room_upload, room_listen, room_task, room_webhook · Destructive: room_workspace, room_listen, room_task.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: room_listen, room_minutes, room_task, room_webhook · Private data: room_join, room_send, room_upload, project_knowledge, project_memory · Public sink: room_send, room_upload, room_listen, room_task, room_webhook · Destructive: room_workspace, room_listen, room_task

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
